title: Your appendix may not be as useless as once thought
body: The appendix, a small worm-shaped pouch off the large intestine, was long dismissed as a pointless evolutionary leftover. Since the early 2000s researchers have proposed real roles for it, though they are still being studied. It is rich in immune tissue, and a leading idea is that it serves as a safe house for beneficial gut bacteria, helping to repopulate the intestines after an illness such as a bout of severe diarrhoea.

slides.prompt: If the appendix does have a job, what is the leading idea?
slides.answer: A safe house for beneficial gut bacteria
